title: Pear
body:
"Pears are sweet, juicy fruits with a distinctive bell shape."

Description

The Pear is a item that can be found on Birch trees.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $150 per Pear. In its jam form it may be sold for $550.

Grants a small health boost when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~3.42% per pear.
